Package org.tasktide.engine.policies.workflow

Interface WorkflowAcquisitionStrategy

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractWorkflowStrategy, RoundRobinWorkflowStrategy, SequentialWorkflowStrategy
public interface WorkflowAcquisitionStrategy
Defines specifications for different ways to fetch workload from a collection of steps
